title: EATF Agent Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Agent Evidence Packages (.aep): TypeScript and Python verifiers, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, JSON schemas, runnable examples, and positive/negative conformance vectors. Version 0.3.0 adds stable machine-readable first-failure codes, a fixed model-based oracle, and a deterministic 21-case decision-path corpus. The preserved confirmatory run records 21/21 oracle matches and 21/21 TypeScript/Python verdict-and-code matches across two accepting paths and 16 distinct rejection states.
notes: Create version 0.3.0 as a new version under concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21511608. The prior v0.2.0 archive is doi:10.5281/zenodo.21571908.
